package: READER-BIND ROUND 2 (cux-r2-bind): the refutation round's reproduced regressions of the release-side reader rules - the lead's L1 (a 'Label: <service>' heading opens a report part), P1 rule 1 (lesion labels), P1 rule 2 (attributive act compounds) and P1 rule 4 (a combined report's site-less denials) - repaired so each fails closed
summary: Findings L1/R07, L1/R10, L2/F01, L2/F03 (L1), L2/F04, L2/F06 (rule 1), L2/F05 (rule 2) and L2/F02 (rule 4) of /home/claude/cpt-studio-ux-20261103/refute-r2/results.json, each REPRODUCED by a verifier and reproduced again on this branch's base c47d71a34 (scratch-r2-reader/out-start.json). Every rule below reads structure the document already gives and makes the rule it repairs hold where the document does not settle the reading: an input the installed revision 41e03656d held is held again, and an act is never moved into a service the document does not give it. Where a repair restores a reading of the installed revision that is a release against this base (an act given back to the service the document gives it), the movement is named here, row by row.
base: c47d71a34d23d4b2f17a8705a7b63260590423a9 (the integrated feature branch; installed revision 41e03656df617d5fab4a551ba7a0d7aea5ca3380)
standard: Round-4 (ruling 2026-11-03 (g); R8 section 4) and the refutation round's brief: when the document does not settle a reading, hold or ask - never release, never exclude a supported code. Every earlier repair stays (Mara's acceptance, every declared row of cux-bind.json, cux-hold.json and cux-lead.json). Any movement not declared below is a finding, measured and amended (dated, after code) before it is accepted.

rules.L1a: services.parts(): a 'Label: <service>' line opens no part inside a plan or history part (parts()'s own heading) or inside a plan or history section of routing's layout (sections.layout().section_at): it is that plan's or that history's line, as installed (F01: 'Plan:' / 'Recommendations:' / 'Impression and Recommendations:' over 'Second procedure: Colonoscopy with cold snare polypectomy').
rules.L1b: services.parts(): the part a labelled heading opens starts at the line after the heading; the heading line itself stays in the part it is in and reads exactly as installed - it gives its service no report-title reading (no performed title, no report_title) and lists no act on a procedure line (F01's snare on the label line; F01's cancelled separate note 'Separate note: Colonoscopy' over 'The colonoscopy was cancelled ...', excluded as installed).
rules.L1c: services.LABELLED_NOTE: a numbered 'Procedure N' line is a field of today's report, as 'Procedure:' is (the R8 1.3 trap), never a note label; 'subsequent' and 'follow-on' name a later procedure, never a same-day note; and in parts() a labelled line next to another labelled line that names a service (a list of today's procedures: 'Note 1: EGD' / 'Note 2: Colonoscopy') opens no part (F03). 'Separate same-day note:' is a note label (R10b: two of the label's own modifiers).
rules.L1d: services.parts(): R8 D7's fail-closed half (R8-history-defects.md section 1.3 table, D7; never built). A note label line (LABELLED_NOTE) naming one or more services, none of them the running part's own, that labelled_service_heading does not accept - extra words, another date form, another time, a plan, two services - outside a plan or history and not in a list (L1a, L1c): the text after it is no longer the running part's. It opens a part of no family, of the running part's kind; inside a titled report it is a report part read as a combined report's is (rule 4): its acts are placed only by their own site, sentence, lesion or the document's one procedure, and its site-less denials are set beside every service that documents the act done (R10: the rectal biopsy under 'Separate note: Flexible sigmoidoscopy (fictional) on 2026-10-14' is no longer the colonoscopy's, so 45380 is held).
rules.L1e: services._build pass 3: in a part a note label opened for the flexible sigmoidoscopy (L1, or L1d's unplaced part after a refused label naming it), a lesion or an act any of whose own sites lies beyond a sigmoidoscope's reach - CPT's definition of sigmoidoscopy: the rectum, the sigmoid colon and a portion of the descending colon; the splenic flexure, the transverse colon, the hepatic flexure, the ascending colon, the cecum with its valve and orifice and the ileum are beyond it - is placed as it was before the heading: by the part the heading interrupted (R07: 'A 5 mm polyp in the cecum was removed with a cold snare.' after the note is the colonoscopy's again, 45385 READY and 45338 held, as installed). Sites a sigmoidoscope reaches, and acts naming none, stay the note's (R07v3, the sigmoid snare inside the note: unchanged).
rules.R1a: services._build pass 3 (P1 rule 1): a label or a specimen reference binds an act only where the act's own part, its sentence's named service or the document's one procedure gives it no family, or gives it the bound lesion's own service: never an act of one service moved to another service's lesion (F04 (a) 'Biopsies were then taken with the same cold forceps used to retrieve COL-1.' and (b) '(specimen 1)' inside the UPPER ENDOSCOPY section read as installed).
rules.R1b: services._unique_labels (P1 rule 1): a label defined on more than one line resolves only where every definition names a site; a definition that names none ('P1: a 9 mm sessile polyp.' under 'Stomach:') may describe another lesion, and which one the label names is not told (F04 (c)).
rules.R1c: services._bound_lesion (P1 rule 1): an act whose own clause names a site binds to a labelled lesion only where each such site is the lesion's own site, or the site of the whole of its region ('colon' over the ascending colon); a clause naming another segment of the same tract ('No snare was used on COL-1 in the sigmoid colon.' for an ascending-colon COL-1) reads as installed (F06).
rules.R2a: services._acts_in / _build pass 3 (P1 rule 2): an act word heading a hyphenated participle compound that no auxiliary or subject makes a predicate is attributive only where a noun phrase follows it ('the snare-treated sigmoid lesion', 'biopsy-proven Barrett esophagus', 'two snare-resected polyps'). Anywhere else - a field label ('Snare-resected: No', 'Hot snare-resected: Not done'), a coordinated or negated predicate ('was neither snare-resected nor retrieved'), the end of a clause - it is a doubtful compound: the inventory keeps it, as installed, only when its clause denies or cancels the act (the denial stands and a genuine same-lesion conflict is kept), and leaves it out otherwise (as now: no performed reading ever rests on it, so L3's release is unchanged). _acts_in's result for every other reader is unchanged (F05).
rules.R4a: services._build pass 3 (P1 rule 4): in a combined report, a site-less, label-less prose denial that read_clause reads negated or cancelled is set beside every service that documents the act done whatever date or history word its clause carries - read_clause has already read the clause's own time - as the installed revision kept it with the combined title's first service; the date, history and plan exclusions stay on the field and box path they were written for (F02: 'No biopsies were taken on 2026-11-03.', 'No biopsies were taken, as previously documented.').
